guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, absorbed_o is reset to prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4False.
When rst_ni is high, absorbed_o is updated to the value of absorbed_d on every rising edge of clk_i.

assumptions.claim: absorbed_d must be a valid MuBi4-encoded value (either true or false) whenever absorbed_o is updated, otherwise absorbed_o may become an illegal encoding.
assumptions.cond: rst_ni == 1 and rising edge of clk_i
assumptions.risk: Downstream logic expecting a valid mubi signal may misbehave, potentially affecting security-critical control flow.

uncertain_points.claim: The source of absorbed_d is not checked in this chunk; it must be guaranteed to output a legal MuBi4 value to preserve the mubi encoding safety of absorbed_o.
uncertain_points.risk: If the source produces an illegal mubi value, absorbed_o will propagate it, possibly violating mubi encoding assumptions in downstream consumers, leading to incorrect state transitions or data bypass.
